notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 terminal timestamped-interaction retraction boundary. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies retraction terminalization across Time Advance Request, Time Advance Request Available, Next Message Request, Next Message Request Available, and Flush Queue Request without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped SendInteraction, Retract, and alternate advance services with FederateAmbassador delivery and grant callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped retraction and alternate-advance declarations
